name: Hydro-Thunder-Online-Dedicated-Server
author: DaedheldirPR@github.com
description:
A tiny, standalone matchmaker and UDP relay that allows players to play the Hydro Thunder Windows port together over the internet.

One person runs this server and shares its address with the other players. Everyone enters the same address in the game's **PC Settings → Network → Master Server** menu. Once in-game, one player hosts a match while the others join. Players can then find and join each other's matches.

This repository contains only the server. You will need the game itself to use it. See the [HydroThunderOnline repository](https://github.com/LANCommander/HydroThunderOnline) for more information.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

set -e

cd /mnt/server

echo "Downloading Hydro Thunder Online htmaster..."

curl -L \
    "https://github.com/LANCommander/HydroThunderOnline/releases/download/v1.0.0/htmaster-v1.0.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz" \
    -o htmaster.tar.gz

echo "Download complete."

echo "Extracting htmaster.tar.gz..."

tar -xzf htmaster.tar.gz

echo "Archive extracted."

echo "Looking for htmaster..."

HTMASTER=$(find . -type f -name "htmaster" -print -quit)

if [ -z "$HTMASTER" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: htmaster was not found."
    echo "Files after extraction:"
    find . -maxdepth 5 -print
    exit 1
fi

echo "Found: $HTMASTER"

echo "Moving htmaster to server root..."

mv "$HTMASTER" ./htmaster

chmod +x ./htmaster

echo "Removing archive..."

rm -f htmaster.tar.gz

echo ""
echo "======================================"
echo " Hydro Thunder Online installed!"
echo "======================================"
echo ""

ls -lah /mnt/server
